source: Brown et al. (2001), Hubble Space Telescope Time-Series Photometry of the Transiting Planet of HD 209458, ApJ 552, 699 (https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/0101336), Table 1
note: Both coefficients fitted freely to Hubble transits of HD 209458b, published as their sum and difference; u1 and u2 are those combinations solved, with each uncertainty half the quadrature sum of the two. The paper notes that u1 - u2 is poorly constrained; the sum, which sets the edge brightness (1 - u1 - u2 = 0.36), is well measured.
